coverageSpotVerification.detail: evidence/coverage-all.json and the grader-run m*-coverage.json map every suite-required assertion of M1–M6 and M8 to a test. All 20 sampled mappings run code that exercises the assertion's observable, and grader-run suites passed 31/31 tests. Three mappings are narrower than their text, but none is dishonest, and grader execution confirmed each observable: m3-a15 re-runs every installed segment but compares only the messages count (the grader found all 15 tables unchanged); m2-a16 checks repost attribution at the data level rather than the rendered label (the grader saw the 'Reposted by' label); m5-a05 checks second-open denial through the opened state and SDK asset refusal rather than a second UI tap (the grader tapped twice). m8-a05..a07 delegate to scripts/prove-m8.mjs on an isolated clock-advanced instance, which is legitimate; the grader re-derived these with its own isolated test.

defects.summary: Following feed silently drops a followed author once that author passes 50 followers while the reader already holds 32 'shared-author' pull slots (feedPulls cap 32 by readerId; the promotion loop ignores feedTryPull's false). The reader still shows as following, but the author's new posts never reach their Following feed. Following a 33rd author with more than 50 followers is refused with FEED_PULL_CAP, and the profile follow button discards the failed write with no message. Reproduced on an isolated instance; the scale fixtures stay under the threshold (only the celebrity is shared), so the replay did not hit it.
defects.evidence: trace.md#a10 pull-cap (results/p10-pullcap.json: follow33rdPopular=FEED_PULL_CAP, readerStillFollowsQ=true, readerSeesQPost=false, freshFollowerSeesQPost=true); snapback/feed.q feedTryPull/feedAddFollow; src/Main.tsx ProfileCard onPressFollow

defects.summary: URLs in chat messages render in link style with role=link, but tapping them does nothing: src/Chat.tsx Bubble never passes onPressLink to the kit's MessageBubble. This breaks the global links ruling (http(s) URLs in any text open the system browser). Post links work.
defects.evidence: trace.md#w2 defect-probe.message-link-tappable (linkNodes 1, no popup); src/Chat.tsx Bubble props; ui/src/linkify.tsx

defects.summary: Every DM is stored with the fixed name 'Direct message', so global message search shows the same 'DIRECT MESSAGE' header for every DM group. Results are grouped per chat, but the groups can't be told apart.
defects.evidence: trace.md#w2 m5-a09-a11 (groupLabels ['DIRECT MESSAGE','WEB GROUP …','DIRECT MESSAGE']); snapback/chat.q createDM name; src/Chat.tsx Search groupLabel

defects.summary: API.md's only recipe for finding a named conversation matches conversation.name, but every DM is named 'Direct message'. API.md doesn't document how to resolve a DM's counterpart (pairLo/pairHi principals vs. handles via profile/socialProfile), so a third party can't fetch 'the DM with Bob' from API.md alone.

Insights 'received' totals include the user's own activity (self-likes, self-replies and self-reposts are counted because the maintains group by author without excluding the viewer). 'Posts' counts originals only. Both are defensible readings, but they are undocumented.
defects.evidence: trace.md#w5 m8-a01 (self-reply counted in repliesReceived); snapback/insights.q maintains

O1.anchorsCited: Interpolated between ~60 ('M1–M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap') and ~90 ('every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts').
O1.justification: Independent grading passed 101/119 in-scope assertions (85/101 M1–M7, 16/18 M8). M1–M5 passed 79/79; the builder suite, grader-run choreography and grader API/web checks agree. M6 passed 6/13 and M8 16/18: every web/API assertion passed, but the 9 native-artifact assertions have no simulator artifact, so they score not-passed. M7 is 0/9 because the fresh-session milestone was never attempted, and it stays in the denominator. That blocks the 90 anchor; quality on everything that was built is high.

O2.anchorsCited: Between ~60 ('a few medium defects off the happy path') and ~90 ('only cosmetic nits'), closer to 60.
O2.justification: No crashes, broken flows or wrong data on any checklist path. One major defect off the happy path (d-01): silent Following-feed loss plus a refused follow once a reader follows more than 32 authors with >50 followers. Two minor defects: chat links not tappable (d-02) and DM addressing missing from API.md (d-04). Two cosmetic items (d-03, d-05). See defects[].

O4.anchorsCited: Between ~30 ('cold-start offline shows an empty or broken app') and ~60 ('reads work; offline writes lost or mis-ordered, or receipts wrong after flush'), near 30. The ~90 anchor requires the native proof.
O4.justification: The mechanically checkable basis is the harness receipts. The grader-run and builder web segments show offline-queued messages marked pending, flushed in order, and reaching read (m6); warm-offline search (m5); and same-account live delivery, cross-device read state and dual-offline convergence with normal receipts (m8). No simulator artifact exists for M6 or M8 (ios-simulator-m6/m8 status not-recorded), so cold-start offline reads, media, search, view-once non-rendering and durable-queue restart are not demonstrated on any scored artifact. The lane states this gap honestly (README, native-artifacts.json, proof labels), and its Node process-replica proofs are builder evidence that O4 may not use.

O5.bandRationale: First match in order 0, 30, 60, 90, 75, taken from the replay record the lane produced (the harness recorded no o5Inputs). Branch 0 did not fire: the builder's final verification matched invariant-manifest-combined.json exactly, including the named O5 fixtures, and the grader's API spot-check of the final scale store confirmed it (u0500 follows 500 in 100 chats; u0005 follows 5; u0900 has 900 followers; u0901 follows exactly u0001–u0004 + u0900; g0001 has its 50-member roster and 10,000 unique messages by full paging; 10 seeded-sampled chats had exact counts; 9 sampled users resolved by people search). The hidden committed sampling seed does not exist. The replay completed (913.6 s on its own clock), and no numeric cap exists, so none was exhausted. Branch 30 fired: the Insights mid-curve rule fails as written in the brief. The 50% checkpoint p95 of 1.915 ms is above the 10%→100% line value of 1.818 ms (10% 1.855 ms, 100% 1.772 ms; recomputed from evidence/scale-m8-*-probes.json, k=20 after 3 warm-ups), and the builder's own performance-summary.json records insightsMidCurveLiteralPass=false. The 50-member receipt-aggregation stall rule was never measured. All other rules pass with wide margins: deep paging 1.06×, 500-vs-5 follow feed 1.16×, search full vs 10% 1.09× (mid-curve OK), celebrity write 0.50×, celebrity read 1.10×, Insights full vs 10% 0.96×, Trending 1.06× (mid-curve OK), cold sync 6.1 s. Provisional: the failing margin (0.097 ms) is within measurement noise, and the degradation predicates were meant to be frozen with a probe set that was never committed. Absolute ceilings and the replay cap are uncalibrated placeholders, so branches 60, 90 and 75 could not have been evaluated anyway.
